name: Window calibration
_about: Calibration for the HUD's visible window (Nov 7 2026): lines every 50 px with x/y labels every 100 over the whole 800x480 target, and a cyan frame where the layouts assume the window is today (120,100 560x280: BMW's height-adjust frame in a Nov 7 car photo, measured Nov 9). Photograph it while moving the HUD's height in iDrive, so BMW's own adjustment frame shows the real edges next to the grid.
